history.title: How it All Started
history.story: Founded in 2010 by a group of passionate educators and parents, Good Seed Daycare was born out of a simple vision: to create a space where education feels like an adventure and safety feels like home. Over the last 15 years, we have grown from a single classroom to a world-class facility, but our core mission has never changed—planting the seeds of excellence in every child we serve.
